templates.why_chosen: The Tile-graph row shows a real merge, two input nodes converging into the first operator, before flowing through alternating orange/blue nodes, nested inside a layered compiler stack down to a memory hierarchy.
templates.what_to_learn: Even a mostly-linear operator graph earns dataflow-dag treatment the moment two nodes merge into one, so draw that merge explicitly (two boxes, one arrowhead) rather than smoothing it into a chain, and carry a highlighted path in one colour (red) down through the memory-hierarchy bands it maps onto.
